entries.description: Read spec + guidance; registered start; baseline-committed scaffolding (session-start ref 60490e6).

Added PackAsTool/ToolCommandName=access-harvester/PackageId=Dabbler.AccessHarvester.Tool + metadata; RID-gated the single-file publish props so they do not leak into pack/build (risk #1). Evidence: CLI has no Microsoft.Data.Sqlite dependency (SymbolDb-only), so risk #2's SQLite premise does not apply; corrected the false SQLite comment.

dotnet pack -> local feed -> global install -> 4 hermetic smoke checks pass (--version/--help/parse 214 nodes/validate schema v1.1) from ~/.dotnet/tools; package confirmed NOT single-file with ANTLR+OleDb assets + DotnetToolSettings.xml.
Extended docs/harvester/install.md with the dotnet tool channel (Option A/B, SDK-to-install vs runtime-to-run, host caveats).
Solution build green; PackagedBinarySmokeTests 5/5 (self-contained publish unchanged, single-file exe, 0 loose DLLs).

Ran the Set-075 greenfield verification matrix (push:anthropic claude-sonnet-4-6 + pull:openai gpt-5.4; pull:google skipped DeterministicServantViolation) on 60490e6..WORKTREE. diffClass=packaging-small. Adjudicated union=1 TP (F2 doc schema-version staleness, caught by pull:openai); 2 FP. Froze matrix-run/ + adjudication.md + metadata.json; shipped telemetry to dabbler-ai-orchestration 075 (committed+pushed).

Routed cross-provider session-verification (gpt-5-4). R1 ISSUES_FOUND: 2 Major (install.md SDK-vs-runtime; packed README used wrong command name). Fixed both (SDK/runtime distinction; added tool-specific nuget-readme.md + repointed PackageReadmeFile). R2 VERIFIED, 0 issues.
Read spec + guidance + workflow; registered session 2 start (session-start ref 0fb87b8). Confirmed router 0.26.1, keys present (DABBLER_-prefixed).

Resolved the S1-deferred package license: owner chose MIT (ecosystem-consistent with dabbler-platform). Added PackageLicenseExpression=MIT + PackageRequireLicenseAcceptance=false + Copyright to the CLI csproj; root LICENSE (MIT) + THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt; SourceLink + snupkg symbols (pack/publish-scoped). Evidence: CLI dep closure = ANTLR (BSD-3-Clause) + System.Data.OleDb/JsonSchema.Net/Humanizer/json-everything (MIT), no copyleft.

Added .github/workflows/nuget-publish.yml (tag-triggered nuget-v*, namespaced away from the existing v*.*.* release.yml). OIDC trusted publishing (NuGet/login@v1, id-token:write, environment gate), build-once/promote-artifacts, --skip-duplicate, .snupkg symbols. Guardrails: version-drift guard (tag == Directory.Build.props <Version>), package-ID/typo assertion, smoke install+run from local feed, workflow_dispatch GitHub-Packages dry run. Actions pinned to commit SHAs (platform precedent).

Added docs/harvester/nuget-publish.md runbook (one-time maintainer setup + tag flow + guardrail table); updated install.md availability note. Cross-repo: pinned the migration-orchestrator playbook Step 00 <CONFIRM> + workaround-ledger elimination path (honest framing: pipeline landed, package not yet live until first tagged publish + nuget.org setup).

dotnet build (Release) green; AccessHarvester.Tests 703 passed/2 skipped/0 failed; dotnet pack -> Dabbler.AccessHarvester.Tool.1.2.0.nupkg + .snupkg (nuspec license=MIT expr, DotnetTool type); local-feed install -> access-harvester --version = 'AccessHarvester 1.2.0 (schema v1.1)', --help exit 0.

Ran the Set-075 greenfield matrix (push:anthropic sonnet + pull:openai gpt-5.4 + pull:google gemini; skipped=0, no DeterministicServantViolation this run) on 0fb87b8..WORKTREE. diffClass=packaging-small. adjudicated_union_TP=0: all 5 consolidated findings were push-only FP/artifacts (F1/F3 push-elision of the session's new untracked files THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt + nuget-publish.md which DO exist; F2 dup; F4/F5 ISSUES_FOUND parse fragments); both pull arms returned clean VERIFIED. 2nd Set-019 data point counter to the packaging-small=favors-push prior. Froze matrix-run/ (preserved S1 as matrix-run-s1/); telemetry shipped to 075.

Routed cross-provider session-verification (gpt-5-4). R1 ISSUES_FOUND 1 Major: THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt only NAMED the MIT deps without their notices. Evidence-checked the .nupkg (a dotnet tool bundles its dep DLLs, no <dependencies>) -> rewrote notices with full MIT text + .NET Foundation/Greg Dennis copyrights. R2 ISSUES_FOUND 1 Minor only (notices 'see LICENSE' but LICENSE not packed) -> per Set-071 materiality a Minor-only round is effectively VERIFIED; fixed anyway by packing LICENSE at the package root. No blocking findings remain.
